notes.title: EON Fighter: Version 1.0 now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42181174/b8f803078636202e954b167faa237721b15d070d.png

The awaited day has come! I'm pleased to announce that EON Fighter has reached its full 1.0 version on Steam. I want to extend a deep thank you to every player who has accompanied me on this journey, offering their unwavering support and allowing me to grow at every stage of development.

This year has been a whirlwind of emotions, filled with learnings, challenges, and the fortune of crossing paths with extraordinary people. I'm more motivated than ever, and I believe that EON Fighter is just the beginning of many more adventures to share.

I sincerely hope you enjoy the game and, as always, I'm open and attentive to your valuable feedback.

Thank you for being a part of this story!

[previewyoutube=aLZvIMz7YmA;full][/previewyoutube]

EON FIGHTER

notes.title: Post launch update!
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug when exiting a level and entering another quickly that crashed the game.

- Fixed bug where extreme mode allowed you to access even if you didn't meet the requirements.

- Slight decrease in the firing speed of the first boss, 45 to 50 milliseconds.

During development, and thanks to the feedback from those who played the betas, I decided to make Tilebreaker a challenging game. Finding that point has not been easy and surely it is still necessary to tweak some variables.

Many thanks to those who bought the game.

I'm looking forward to your feedback to keep improving!
